e.title: 「我没有回头去调生成器，好让它产出一个更好看的数」：一份把原样跑出的零结果、机会水平的模型和明知会大量触发的检查全部保留并解释原因的保险分析项目
e.title_en: I did not adjust the generator retroactively to produce a nicer-looking number: an insurance analytics project that keeps its null result, its chance-level model and a check it knew would fire heavily, and explains each one
e.title_hk: 「我沒有回頭去調生成器，好讓它產出一個更好看的數」：一份把原樣跑出的零結果、機會水平的模型和明知會大量觸發的檢查全部保留並解釋原因的保險分析項目
e.summary: 一份财险理赔与核保风险分析项目，自述「受保险分析岗位中常见的理赔与风险分析工作启发」，数据全部为 Python 生成的合成数据；**其最突出之处不是它算出了什么，而是它把三个「不好看」的结果全部原样留下并逐个解释了原因**：**① 核保风险等级是否真的预测索赔频率——用 Kruskal-Wallis 检验（文档说明为何不用单因素 ANOVA：逐单索赔次数是离散右偏、各组样本量不等，该方法不假设正态与方差齐性），结果 H=1.76、p=0.7798，不显著**，**而它没有把结论写成「风险等级无关」，而是逐字写下「没有证据不等于证据不存在」（Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence），并说明真实数据上出现这种结果应触发对评分模型的复查而不是就此否定风险分级**；**② 欺诈复核标记的预测模型 ROC-AUC 只有 0.516、对被标记类别的召回为零**，**它逐字注明这是「实际跑出来的、未经修改的结果，没有被调整或被重新表述得更好看」**，原因是该标记在合成时是独立随机赋值的（建模样本中占 5.7%）；**③ 有一项数据完整性检查（理赔日期早于保单起保日期）在合成数据上会大量触发**，**它明确说明这是因为保费、核保分数与理赔日期在生成时彼此独立，所以是数据生成方式的必然产物、不是对真实保险数据质量的判断，而它仍然刻意保留这项检查**，理由是「理赔日期相对保单是否讲得通」正是一份真实施赔审计会跑的那种检查；**它还把赔付率异常偏高的根因写在报告里**：样本赔付率约为 4.5 至 5.3 倍，远高于真实保险常见的 0.5 至 0.8 倍，**根因是理赔金额与保费在生成时相互独立**（已付赔款中位数约 3,047 美元对保费中位数约 903 美元）——**并逐字写明「我按原样报告，而不是回头调整生成器去产出一个更好看的数字」**
e.summary_hk: 一份財險理賠與核保風險分析項目，自述「受保險分析崗位中常見的理賠與風險分析工作啟發」，數據全部為 Python 生成的合成數據；**其最突出之處不是它算出了什麼，而是它把三個「不好看」的結果全部原樣留下並逐個解釋了原因**：**① 核保風險等級是否真的預測索賠頻率——用 Kruskal-Wallis 檢驗（文檔說明為何不用單因素 ANOVA：逐單索賠次數是離散右偏、各組樣本量不等，該方法不假設正態與變異數同質性），結果 H=1.76、p=0.7798，不顯著**，**而它沒有把結論寫成「風險等級無關」，而是逐字寫下「沒有證據不等於證據不存在」（Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence），並說明真實數據上出現這種結果應觸發對評分模型的複查而不是就此否定風險分級**；**② 欺詐複核標記的預測模型 ROC-AUC 只有 0.516、對被標記類別的召回為零**，**它逐字註明這是「實際跑出來的、未經修改的結果，沒有被調整或被重新表述得更好看」**，原因是該標記在合成時是獨立隨機賦值的（建模樣本中佔 5.7%）；**③ 有一項數據完整性檢查（理賠日期早於保單起保日期）在合成數據上會大量觸發**，**它明確說明這是因為保費、核保分數與理賠日期在生成時彼此獨立，所以是數據生成方式的必然產物、不是對真實保險數據質量的判斷，而它仍然刻意保留這項檢查**，理由是「理賠日期相對保單是否講得通」正是一份真實理賠審計會跑的那種檢查；**它還把賠付率異常偏高的根因寫在報告裡**：樣本賠付率約為 4.5 至 5.3 倍，遠高於真實保險常見的 0.5 至 0.8 倍，**根因是理賠金額與保費在生成時相互獨立**（已付賠款中位數約 3,047 美元對保費中位數約 903 美元）——**並逐字寫明「我按原樣報告，而不是回頭調整生成器去產出一個更好看的數字」**
e.summary_en: A P&C claims and underwriting risk analytics project, self-described as inspired by the kind of claims and risk analytics work common in insurance analytics roles, with all data synthetic and generated in Python; **its most striking feature is not what it computed but that it keeps three unflattering results exactly as they came out and explains each one**: **first, whether the underwriting risk tier actually predicts claim frequency, tested with a Kruskal-Wallis H-test (with the reason it was chosen over one-way ANOVA stated — per-policy claim counts are discrete and right-skewed while the tier groups are unequal in size, and the test assumes neither normality nor equal variance), returning H = 1.76 and p = 0.7798, not significant** — **and rather than writing this up as risk tier having no effect, it states verbatim that absence of evidence is not evidence of absence, and that on real data such a result should trigger a review of the scoring model rather than a conclusion that risk does not matter**; **second, its fraud-review flag model reaches a ROC-AUC of only 0.516 with zero recall on the flagged class**, **annotated verbatim as the actual, unmodified result of running the model, not adjusted or reframed to look better**, because the flag was assigned independently at random (a 5.7% rate in the modelling sample); **and third, one data-integrity check, claims dated before policy inception, fires heavily on the synthetic data** — **stated explicitly as a consequence of premium, underwriting score and claim dates having been generated independently of one another, hence a property of how the data was built and not a claim about real insurance data quality, and deliberately kept anyway** because whether a claim date makes sense relative to its policy is exactly the check a real claims audit would run; **the project also writes the root cause of its own implausible loss ratios into the report**: loss ratios in the sample run from about 4.5x to 5.3x against a real-insurance range of typically 0.5 to 0.8x, **the root cause being that claim amounts were generated independently of premium** (median paid claim around $3,047 against a median premium around $903) — **with the line written verbatim that it is reported as-is rather than adjusting the generator retroactively to produce a nicer-looking number**
e.body:
**insurance-claims-risk-analytics**（仓库 `KiranReddy-data/insurance-claims-risk-analytics`）**是一份财险理赔与核保风险分析项目**：**实测 ★0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 20 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-06（在解冻窗口之内）、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 在 28 个条目中实测不存在——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**README 实测 10,177 字节**；**仓库实测共 28 个条目（16 个文件、12 个目录）**。**其自述逐字为** **「An insurance analytics project covering policy, claims, and underwriting data, inspired by the kind of claims and risk analytics work common in insurance analytics roles.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把『这个数从哪来』写在它旁边」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把这件事推得最远的一条**——**不止写清数的来源，连**「这个数为什么不好看、以及我为什么不去把它弄好看」也写了出来****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 边界声明逐字，且它同时否定三种东西**——**「All data is synthetic, generated in Python with NumPy/Pandas -- **this repository is independent portfolio work and does not contain, reference, or imply access to any real insurer’s proprietary data, confidential work product, or production systems.**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **它逐字否定了三个层次**：**不含有**、**不引用**、**也不暗示可以访问**；**② **否定的对象是三类**：**真实保险公司的专有数据、机密工作成果、生产系统**；**③ **它在**概述第一段**就写了**，**不是免责声明**（**⚠️ 该仓库无 `LICENSE`，故此声明不构成任何授权**——**⭐ 本词条指出：**边界声明与许可是两件事**，**这份项目写清了前者，但缺后者**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其「业务问题」把要检验的三件事连同**目前只是假设**一起写了出来**——**逐字为**：**「An insurance analytics team needs to know whether pricing (premium) is keeping pace with claims cost (loss ratio), whether the underwriting risk tiers assigned at policy issuance actually predict claim experience, and whether claims and policy data are clean enough to trust for reporting.」**；**随后逐字写下方法立场**：**「This project builds one validated analytical layer and **tests all three questions directly against the data, rather than assuming the answers**.」**⭐⭐ **即**它把三个问题声明为**待检验**的，而不是**已成立**的前提**（**⭐ 这是本条目与常见「作品集项目」的分野所在**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **五个分析问题逐字，其中第三问自带方法论要求**——**逐字为**：**「1. What is the loss ratio (paid claims / premium) by policy type?」**；**「2. How does claim severity and denial rate vary by claim type?」**；**「3. Does the underwriting risk tier assigned at policy issuance actually predict claim frequency -- **tested statistically, not just eyeballed**?」**；**「4. Is there a working fraud-review signal that a model could learn from the available claim and policy attributes?」**；**「5. Are there data integrity issues (e.g., claims dated before policy inception) that would undermine any of the above?」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **第三问把「靠统计检验、不是靠肉眼看」直接写进了问题本身**——**⭐ 即**方法要求是问题的一部分，而不是事后补的**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **第四问的措辞是「是否存在**一个可用的**欺诈复核信号」，而**不是**「建一个欺诈模型」**——**⭐ 即**问题本身允许答案是「没有」****（**⭐ 答见下 ⑦**）；**③ **第五问的措辞是「是否**存在会削弱以上任何一条**的数据完整性问题」**——**⭐ 即**数据质量不是走流程，而是被明确挂到前四问的结论可靠性上****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其数据质量一节逐字解释了「为什么这项检查明知会大量触发还要留着」**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处**：**逐字为**：**「That last check flags a large number of records in this dataset -- premium, underwriting score, and claim dates were generated independently of each other and of policy start date, so this is expected given how the synthetic data was built, not a claim about real insurance data quality. It’s included specifically because "does the claim date make sense relative to the policy" is exactly the kind of check a real claims audit would run, and I wanted the project to demonstrate that check even though this dataset triggers it heavily.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① **它先**承认这项检查会大量触发****（**没有把失败藏起来**）；**② **它给出**具体根因**（保费、核保分数、理赔日期三者**彼此独立**生成、也与保单起保日期独立**生成**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它明确划出**「这是数据生成方式的必然产物，不是对真实保险数据质量的判断」****——**⭐ 这正是本轮主题的关键动作：**把一个数的含义边界写明，防止它被读成别的意思****；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它说明**留着这项检查是刻意的****——**理由是**这项检查正是真实理赔审计会跑的那一种**，**「我想让这个项目演示这项检查，即使这个数据集会把它大量触发」**；**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮所收四条中**最直接体现「不要为了好看而把不适用的检查删掉」的一处****（**⭐ 可与第 335 轮站内条目所记「不要静默降级」的做法并读**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把一次**零结果**连同统计选择理由、假设与限度完整写出**——**逐字实测**：**检验选择** **「**Test used**: Kruskal-Wallis H-test, chosen over one-way ANOVA because per-policy claim counts are discrete, right-skewed, and the risk-tier groups are unequal in size -- Kruskal-Wallis doesn’t assume normality or equal variance.」**；**假设** **「H0 -- claim count is drawn from the same distribution across all risk tiers (Unscored, High Risk, Moderate Risk, Standard, Preferred). H1 -- at least one tier’s distribution differs.」**；**结果** **「H = 1.76, p = 0.7798, alpha = 0.05.」**；**解释** **「the analysis did not find statistically significant evidence of differences in claim frequency across the tested risk tiers at the selected significance level. This is not the same as proving risk tier has no effect -- a non-significant result means the data does not support rejecting H0, not that the null hypothesis is confirmed true. **Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.**」**；**业务解释** **「in a real underwriting book, this result would be worth investigating, not dismissing. Risk tiers exist specifically to predict claim experience -- that’s their entire purpose. A non-significant result on real data should trigger a review of the scoring model, not a conclusion that risk doesn’t matter.」**；**为何本数据集如此** **「underwriting_score and claim occurrence were generated independently at random in the synthetic data-generation step, so there’s no simulated causal relationship for the test to detect. This is the expected and correct outcome given how the data was built, and it says nothing about how real underwriting scores relate to real claim experience.」**；**限度** **「this test evaluates claim frequency only, not severity or fraud risk specifically. A single synthetic sample with one random seed cannot rule out a real relationship existing in actual insurance data -- it can only report what this generated sample shows.」**⭐⭐⭐ **五处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「没有证据不等于证据不存在」被逐字写出**——**⭐ 且它进一步区分了「未能拒绝 H0」与「H0 为真」**；**② ⭐⭐ **它把零结果的**业务含义**写成了「应触发复查」而非「风险无关」**——**并给出理由**「风险等级存在的全部目的就是预测索赔经验」**；**③ ⭐⭐ **它给出了零结果的**数据层根因**，**并明确声明「这**说明不了**真实核保分数与真实索赔经验的关系」****；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它的限度声明指出「单一合成样本、一个随机种子，无法排除真实数据中存在关系——它只能报告这个生成样本所显示的情况」****（**⭐ 这是本词条所见对**统计结论可外推范围**写得最克制的一处**）；**⑤ **检验选择本身给了理由，且理由是**分布形态**（离散、右偏、组间不均衡**）而非习惯**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **五个风险等级被逐个点名**——**逐字为** **「(Unscored, High Risk, Moderate Risk, Standard, Preferred)」**⭐⭐ **即**「未评分」本身是一个等级****（**⭐ 这是一个容易被忽略但很实际的划分：**分数缺失的记录不会被丢掉，而是自成一档****；**⭐ 而它在数据质量检查里也把「缺失分数」单列为一项**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把欺诈模型的机会水平结果原样写出，并逐字声明未做美化**——**逐字为**：**「The `flagged_for_fraud_review` field in this dataset was assigned independently at random (a 5.7% rate in the modeling sample) rather than being driven by any claim or policy attribute. A gradient boosting model trained to predict it achieves ROC-AUC of 0.516 on held-out data -- effectively chance level, with zero recall on the flagged class. **This is the actual, unmodified result of running the model in `python/fraud_risk_model.py`, not adjusted or reframed to look better.**」**；**并逐字给出**「真实场景下什么会带来信号」**：**「In a real fraud analytics engagement, features like claim-to-premium ratio, time since policy inception, claim frequency history, and adjuster notes would carry real signal; none of those relationships are simulated in this synthetic dataset, so there’s nothing here for a model to learn.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「这是实际跑出来的、未经修改的结果，没有被调整或被重新表述得更好看」****——**⭐ 本词条认为这句是本轮主题**说得最明白的一句**（**⭐ 它把「我没有修饰」这件事本身写成了条目内容**）；**② ⭐⭐ **它同时给出**标签本身的生成方式**（**独立随机、占比 5.7%**）**——**⭐ 即**模型的失败原因不在模型，而在标签没有信号**，**这一层因果被写清楚了**；**③ ⭐⭐ **它列出四个**未被模拟进去的可用特征**（**理赔对保费比、距起保时长、历史索赔频率、理算员笔记**）——**⭐ 即**它指明了「要让它有信号该补什么」**。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「关键发现」把赔付率异常偏高的根因写在发现里，并逐字声明拒绝事后调参**——**这是本条目最值得引用的一处**：**逐字为**：**「Loss ratios in this sample run from about 4.5x to 5.3x across policy types -- far higher than real insurance loss ratios (typically 0.5-0.8x). Root cause: claim amounts were generated independently of premium (median paid claim ~$3,047 vs. median premium ~$903), so this reflects a property of the synthetic data generator, not a real underwriting result. **I’m reporting it as-is rather than adjusting the generator retroactively to produce a "nicer-looking" number.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **它给出了**对照基准**（**真实保险常见 0.5 至 0.8 倍**）**——**⭐ 即**读者能自己判断 4.5 至 5.3 倍有多不正常****；**② ⭐⭐ **它给出**两个中位数**作为根因证据**（**已付赔款约 $3,047 对保费约 $903**）**——**⭐ 即**根因不是推测，而是两个数并排**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字拒绝**回头调整生成器**以产出更好看的数**——**⭐ 本词条指出：**这是一个**反向**的诚实动作**——**通常作品集项目的问题是数字太好看，这里的做法是**保留难看的数字并解释它为什么难看****；**④ **它把这一条放在**「关键发现」**而非脚注里**（**⭐ 即**把它当成发现本身**）。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **其「业务建议」三条，第一条直接由上面的难看数字推出**：**逐字为** **「Before trusting a loss ratio metric in any real reporting context, verify that premium and claims data are actually linked at the policy level the way this project’s synthetic version is not -- this is the first thing I’d check given the finding above.」**；**第二条** **「Treat a non-significant risk-tier test result as a prompt to audit the underwriting scoring methodology, not as confirmation that risk-based pricing doesn’t matter.」**；**第三条** **「Don’t deploy a fraud model without confirming the label itself carries real signal first -- fit a simple model and check whether performance clears chance level before investing in a more complex one.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **三条建议**各自对应前面三个难看结果之一**，**且第一条明确说**「这正是我基于上述发现会首先检查的东西」****——**⭐ 即**建议是从结果反推出来的，不是通用套话****；**② ⭐⭐ **第三条**可直接迁移**：**先拟合一个简单模型、看它是否超过机会水平，再决定要不要投更复杂的模型**——**⭐ 这一条对任何做机器学习项目的同学都成立**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**这一做法在其他领域的最优性**，**只记录其被如此写下**）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **其数据模型与文件布局逐字，且它交代了 SQL 的方言**：**`sql/transformations/01_build_analytical_tables.sql` 逐字构建** **`dim_policy`、`fact_claim`、`dim_policy_risk_tier`（**score-based risk banding**）、`fact_policy_loss_ratio`（**the loss ratio base table**）**；**⭐ 即**一张事实表专门承载赔付率**；**⭐ 并逐字说明** **「SQL scripts use a Postgres-style dialect and are meant to run against a warehouse loaded with the same synthetic CSVs.」**；**⭐ 数据质量检查**在 SQL 与 Python 两处**都实现**（**`sql/validation/01_data_quality_checks.sql` 与 `python/data_quality_checks.py`**）**。**⑪ ⭐⭐ **其看板如实说明「只有规格、没有成品文件」，并给出原因**——**逐字为** **「Documented as a build specification rather than a rendered file, since Power BI Desktop wasn’t available while building this -- see `dashboards/insurance_dashboard_spec.md`.」**；**局限一节再次逐字重复** **「The dashboard is a specification, not a working file, due to no Power BI Desktop access while building this.」**⭐⭐ **即**它没有用截图或描述来充当成品**，**而是**把「这里没有成品、原因是环境不具备」写成两处**（**⭐ 本词条认为这与本轮 [[insurance-portfolio-performance]] 提交了可直接打开的 `.pbix` **insurance-claims-risk-analytics**（倉庫 `KiranReddy-data/insurance-claims-risk-analytics`）**是一份財險理賠與核保風險分析項目**：**實測 ★0、主語言 Python、體量 20 KB、創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-06（在解凍窗口之內）、無 topics**；**⚠️ 實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 在 28 個條目中實測不存在——屬「完全未聲明」形態）**；**README 實測 10,177 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 28 個條目（16 個文件、12 個目錄）**。**其自述逐字為** **「An insurance analytics project covering policy, claims, and underwriting data, inspired by the kind of claims and risk analytics work common in insurance analytics roles.」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把『這個數從哪來』寫在它旁邊」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**把這件事推得最遠的一條**——**不止寫清數的來源，連**「這個數為什麼不好看、以及我為什麼不去把它弄好看」也寫了出來****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 邊界聲明逐字，同時否定三種東西**：**「All data is synthetic, generated in Python with NumPy/Pandas -- **this repository is independent portfolio work and does not contain, reference, or imply access to any real insurer’s proprietary data, confidential work product, or production systems.**」**⭐⭐ **三處**：**① 逐字否定三個層次**（不含有、不引用、也不暗示可以訪問）；**② 否定對象是三類**（真實保險公司的專有數據、機密工作成果、生產系統）；**③ 寫在**概述第一段**，不是免責聲明**（**⚠️ 該倉庫無 `LICENSE`，故此聲明不構成任何授權**——**⭐ 本詞條指出：**邊界聲明與許可是兩件事****）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其「業務問題」把要檢驗的三件事連同**目前只是假設**一起寫出**：**「An insurance analytics team needs to know whether pricing (premium) is keeping pace with claims cost (loss ratio), whether the underwriting risk tiers assigned at policy issuance actually predict claim experience, and whether claims and policy data are clean enough to trust for reporting.」**；**隨後逐字寫下方法立場**：**「This project builds one validated analytical layer and **tests all three questions directly against the data, rather than assuming the answers**.」**⭐⭐ **即**它把三個問題聲明為**待檢驗**的，而不是**已成立**的前提**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **五個分析問題逐字，其中第三問自帶方法論要求**：**1. What is the loss ratio (paid claims / premium) by policy type?**；**2. How does claim severity and denial rate vary by claim type?**；**3. Does the underwriting risk tier assigned at policy issuance actually predict claim frequency -- **tested statistically, not just eyeballed**?**；**4. Is there a working fraud-review signal that a model could learn from the available claim and policy attributes?**；**5. Are there data integrity issues (e.g., claims dated before policy inception) that would undermine any of the above?**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 第三問把「靠統計檢驗、不是靠肉眼看」直接寫進了問題本身**——**⭐ 即**方法要求是問題的一部分，而不是事後補的**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 第四問的措辭是「是否存在**一個可用的**欺詐複核信號」而不是「建一個欺詐模型」**——**⭐ 即**問題本身允許答案是「沒有」****；**③ 第五問的措辭是「是否存在**會削弱以上任何一條**的數據完整性問題」**——**⭐ 即**數據質量被明確掛到前四問的結論可靠性上****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其數據質量一節逐字解釋「為什麼這項檢查明知會大量觸發還要留著」**：**「That last check flags a large number of records in this dataset -- premium, underwriting score, and claim dates were generated independently of each other and of policy start date, so this is expected given how the synthetic data was built, not a claim about real insurance data quality. It’s included specifically because "does the claim date make sense relative to the policy" is exactly the kind of check a real claims audit would run, and I wanted the project to demonstrate that check even though this dataset triggers it heavily.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① 它先**承認這項檢查會大量觸發**；**② 它給出具體根因**（保費、核保分數、理賠日期三者彼此獨立生成，也與保單起保日期獨立生成）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 它明確劃出「這是數據生成方式的必然產物，不是對真實保險數據質量的判斷」**——**⭐ 這正是本輪主題的關鍵動作：**把一個數的含義邊界寫明，防止它被讀成別的意思****；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 它說明**留著這項檢查是刻意的**——理由是這項檢查正是真實理賠審計會跑的那一種，「我想讓這個項目演示這項檢查，即使這個數據集會把它大量觸發」**；**⭐ 本詞條認為這是本輪所收四條中**最直接體現「不要為了好看而把不適用的檢查刪掉」的一處****。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把一次**零結果**連同統計選擇理由、假設與限度完整寫出**：**檢驗選擇** **「**Test used**: Kruskal-Wallis H-test, chosen over one-way ANOVA because per-policy claim counts are discrete, right-skewed, and the risk-tier groups are unequal in size -- Kruskal-Wallis doesn’t assume normality or equal variance.」**；**假設** **「H0 -- claim count is drawn from the same distribution across all risk tiers (Unscored, High Risk, Moderate Risk, Standard, Preferred). H1 -- at least one tier’s distribution differs.」**；**結果** **「H = 1.76, p = 0.7798, alpha = 0.05.」**；**解釋** **「…This is not the same as proving risk tier has no effect -- a non-significant result means the data does not support rejecting H0, not that the null hypothesis is confirmed true. **Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.**」**；**業務解釋** **「in a real underwriting book, this result would be worth investigating, not dismissing. Risk tiers exist specifically to predict claim experience -- that’s their entire purpose. A non-significant result on real data should trigger a review of the scoring model, not a conclusion that risk doesn’t matter.」**；**為何本數據集如此** **「underwriting_score and claim occurrence were generated independently at random in the synthetic data-generation step, so there’s no simulated causal relationship for the test to detect. This is the expected and correct outcome given how the data was built, and it says nothing about how real underwriting scores relate to real claim experience.」**；**限度** **「this test evaluates claim frequency only, not severity or fraud risk specifically. What is the loss ratio (paid claims / premium) by policy type?**; **2. How does claim severity and denial rate vary by claim type?**; **3. Does the underwriting risk tier assigned at policy issuance actually predict claim frequency -- tested statistically, not just eyeballed?**; **4. Is there a working fraud-review signal that a model could learn from the available claim and policy attributes?**; **5. Are there data integrity issues (e.g., claims dated before policy inception) that would undermine any of the above?** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the third question builds "tested statistically, not just eyeballed" into the question itself, so the method requirement is part of the question rather than a retrofit**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the fourth asks whether there is *a working* fraud-review signal rather than "build a fraud model", so the question itself permits the answer to be no** (⭐ **see ⑦ below**); **and the fifth asks whether integrity issues exist that would undermine any of the above, tying data quality to the reliability of the first four answers rather than treating it as a formality**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its data-quality section explains verbatim why a check it knew would fire heavily was kept** — **the single most notable point in this entry**: **"That last check flags a large number of records in this dataset -- premium, underwriting score, and claim dates were generated independently of each other and of policy start date, so this is expected given how the synthetic data was built, not a claim about real insurance data quality.
